Name: Lumisteria Garden Decorations
Author: Lumisteria
TagLine: This mod adds multiple buildables to decorate your farm with. Comes with seasonal variation !
Description:
In this pack you'll find 5 different buildables you can add to your farm. All of them are only decorative, and come with a flavor text.

Each buildable has seasonal variations !

Press F2 in game to see the building tab and choose which one you want to build. They cost some money and a bit of material.
